content:
Returns a list of domains and their details for the specified account UUID.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
Example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6
The UUID of the customer account you want to retrieve domains for.
account_uuid
required
